Yunara Build Guide: [🏆] NEW YUNARA ADC GUIDE ⭐Unlock her true potential!

passive.name: Vow of the First Lands
passive.text: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Cultivation of Spirit
spells.text: Yunara gains Attack Speed, bonus damage On-Hit, and her Attacks spread to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin
spells.text: Yunara fires a spinning prayer bead that deals damage and slows enemies. While in her Transcendent State she instead fires off a laser that deals damage and slows enemies.

spells.name: Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow
spells.text: Yunara gains Move Speed and becomes Ghosted. While in her Transcendent State she instead dashes in a direction.

spells.name: Transcend One's Self
spells.text: Yunara enters a Transcendent State that upgrades her basic Abilities.

damage.value: Yunara deals sustained auto-attack damage that ramps up over time.

archetype.value: Yunara is a scaling ADC who relies on spacing and teamfight positioning.

axis.value: Yunara favors longer trades that give her damage time to ramp up.

winCondition.value: Yunara wins through scaling DPS and a strong teamfight presence.

spikes.why: Yunara gets stronger while her ultimate keeps Q active for 15 seconds without stacking it.
Yunara gains a strong first-item spike because her rapid attacks trigger its bonus damage quickly.
Yunara becomes stronger for 15 seconds as her Q, W, and E evolve.

bait.why: After Yunara spends W, its damage and slow are unavailable for 10 seconds.
After Yunara spends E, its movement effect is unavailable for 9 seconds.
After Yunara spends R, Yunara cannot activate its ability upgrades again until its 100/90/80-second cooldown ends.
